newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila yr-on-yr production indices down in March.
newsitem.headline: Manila yr-on-yr production indices down in March.

text.p: The Philippine value of production index fell 2.3 percent in March to 460.2 from 470.8 in the same period last year, the National Statistics Office said on Friday.
The volume of production index also fell, dropping 3.6 percent to 154.6 in March.
On a month-on-month basis, the volume of production index went up by 0.6 percent from 153.6 in February.
The value of production index also inched up 0.3 percent from 458.7 in the previous month.
The indices provide flash indicators on the performance of key manufacturing enteprises.
The statistics office surveyed 422 establishments located mostly in Manila.

On a year-on-year basis, miscellaneous manufacturers posted the biggest gain in terms of the value of their output, rising more than 40 percent, while the textile sector was the biggest loser, posting a 34 percent decline.
